summary: Checks whether a value is a function.
description: Classified by its internal tag, so ordinary, `async`, generator and async-generator functions all pass. A class is a function too.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).
returns: `true` when the value is a function; otherwise `false`.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
isFunction(function () {}); // => true
isFunction(async function () {}); // => true
isFunction(Math.max); // => true
isFunction(null); // => false
isFunction("fn"); // => false
isFunction({}); // => false
```
